key_insight: GenDB-V uses AI agents to synthesize database engines specialized for speed while formally proving SQL correctness and program safety.
engineering_relevance: Automated, verified engine generation could reduce manual redesign as hardware and workloads change without relying solely on testing for correctness.
method: Formalize SQL with SQLSpec and construct fixed, implementation-independent synthesis targets.
Jointly synthesize code and modular proofs using storage–execution co-optimization and performance-first exploration.
Check code and proofs against the fixed targets in an isolated verification pipeline.
evidence_signal: On TPC-H and SEC-EDGAR, verified template implementations achieved 22.0–61.3× geometric-mean speedups over DuckDB and Umbra; a verified general-purpose engine achieved 1.27–3.4× speedups on TPC-H.
watch_item: Correctness guarantees are relative to SQLSpec and the supported SQL subset; the reported results do not establish coverage of full SQL or production workloads.
paper_title: Stop Handcrafting Your Engine! GenDB-V: Towards AI-Generated and Formally Verified Database Systems
